tools.name: list_supported
tools.description: List the built-in model names and hardware names this fit-checker knows (for mapping user wording to exact names). Standard text-only HuggingFace transformer configs can also be checked via fitllm.run; unsupported architectures are rejected.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
